name: Repeating Fireball
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level bloodrager 6, magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6
Duration see text

This spell functions as the spell fireball except each round at the beginning of your turn after the initial explosion, the fireball explodes again in the same area.

Each explosion thereafter deals 2d6 less fire damage than the previous round. Each explosion has their own Reflex save to halve the damage.
